domain: national open-data catalog - access excellent, task families duplicate the bench
prediction_question: Two formulations were measured and NOT taken forward: (a) station-level next-day rainfall exceedance at an NEA rain station from its own 5-minute reading history (7,044,646 rows for 2021 alone, ~70 stations, anonymous API) - this duplicates the own-history environmental-exceedance family already carried by cpcb-aqi-exceedance (GO) and noaa-tide-flooding (live); (b) multi-disease weekly outbreak exceedance from the MOH Weekly Infectious Disease Bulletin (20,070 rows, epi_week x disease x cases since 2012-W01) - only ~29 disease entities, the exceedance threshold would be ours rather than a published band edge, and the dengue-forecasting family has the DrivenData DengAI ML-ready precedent (city-level weekly case counts, not exceedance). HDB resale price prediction - the catalog's most-mirrored dataset - exists on Kaggle. PSI exceedance duplicates (a)'s family.
prediction_time: Stated for the not-taken-forward formulations only: (a) 23:59 SGT on day D, all readings through D knowable, D+1 readings are label source; (b) end of epi-week W, bulletin cases published after the week closes.
target_definition: (a) daily station rainfall total on D+1 above a threshold - the threshold would be ours; Singapore's NEA publishes rainfall but no exceedance band edge for daily totals, so the label would not carry a published threshold; (b) disease-week cases above a threshold - again ours, not the publisher's. Both are mechanically derivable from the series; neither carries a publisher-defined decision edge.

rejection_reason: Parked on task-family grounds, with access and licence settled: the catalog is the best-connected publisher measured in this region (fully anonymous v2 catalog + row APIs, machine-readable, permissive licence with attribution) - but a full enumeration of its 4,664 datasets shows every event/series-grain dataset supports a task family the bench already carries or a mirror: own-history environmental exceedance (rainfall/PSI/temperature - the family of cpcb-aqi-exceedance GO, noaa-tide-flooding live, air4thai parked with the same duplication note), outbreak forecasting (DrivenData DengAI precedent, and only ~29 disease entities), HDB resale (Kaggle mirror), real-time snapshots with no archive (carpark, taxi, flood alerts), aggregate statistics (most of the catalog is Singapore DOS tables). The air4thai park already records that a second same-family environmental task needs an explicit operator decision, and this candidate does not claim one.
next_action: Unpark path (a decision, not a re-probe): the operator names which, if any, family to accept - (a) Singapore rainfall exceedance (access/licence settled, extraction measured at ~63M rows for 2016-2024, threshold ours), or (b) MOH multi-disease weekly exceedance (20,070 rows, threshold ours, DengAI adjacency), or (c) neither. Independently of the operator, a quarterly catalog diff (re-run the 467-request enumeration and compare dataset ids) would catch a new event-level register if an agency adds one - that, not a re-probe of the same 4,664 datasets, is the only unpark trigger available.

queries: Singapore rainfall prediction benchmark dataset splits
Weekly Infectious Disease Bulletin Singapore dataset prediction
HDB resale price prediction dataset Kaggle
prior_art: HDB resale transactions are a long-standing Kaggle mirror dataset (prediction notebooks widespread) - a mirror, not a contribution
DrivenData 'DengAI' (2015-): ML-ready weekly dengue case-count prediction for San Juan and Iquitos - adjacent to formulation (b), city-level weekly counts rather than exceedance
Singapore rainfall forecasting papers (NUS/NTU, station or island models with private splits) - models on their own pulls, no packaged task
No packaged train/eval/holdout task with a scored contract was found for any data.gov.sg series
novelty_check.theirs: Kaggle mirrors of the raw resale data; DengAI's ML-ready dengue task on two other cities; rainfall papers with private splits; no packaged task on this publisher's series.
novelty_check.ours: Nothing worth claiming: the only novel formulations (rainfall/disease-week exceedance) duplicate task families the bench already carries and carry no publisher-defined threshold. The park records that access and licence were never the blocker.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
